review_notes: I read the whole file and checked every @[simp] lemma against the related simp lemmas in Tableau.lean, YoungSubgroup.lean and Mathlib's Subgroup/Map.lean. rowIndex_rowYoungConjugator is confluent with rowIndex_relabel and rowYoungConjugator_relabel, and none of the rules can loop. The relabel lemma has a smaller right-hand side and is used by rw in Specht/Module.lean. rowYoungConjugator_youngBlocksEquiv is deliberately non-simp for a documented reason: its Sigma index types contain the sorted-parts list, which simp would rewrite. The two ConjMulEquiv coe lemmas have canonical conjugation right-hand sides, and Mathlib already supplies the underlying subgroupMap and subgroupCongr simp lemmas. The non-terminal simp followed by rfl in those two proofs is a proof-style matter, not a simp-interface defect. I did not run Lean, so no simp behaviour was tested.
